chapter: Reading bands, brass bands and Fate Marable
title: Paul Beaulieu in the TB ward
summary: Allen and Williams discuss Paul Beaulieu's hospital stay and a message for Bill.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You know, I hear Paul Beaulieu has a TB. Hmm? Paul Beaulieu. I went to see him in the hospital. In the Easy Charity? Yeah, in the TB wall.
Well, I had to see him.
Yeah, he told me to tell Bill. He sure forgot to tell him, so you tell him.
He told me. I finally got a...
Yeah, I told Bill. That's right. I went to that one night. TB was on the fourth floor. He had to go see me. He wanted to see all his show. Tell me to tell you all. You and Bill.
